name: agent-company
description: 一个可生长的 AI 多 agent 公司

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.e: npm run build -w server && concurrently -k -s first -n server,web,electron -c green,cyan,magenta "npm run dev:server-for-electron" "cross-env AGENT_COMPANY_ELECTRON_RENDERER=1 npm run dev -w web -- --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on file:server/dist/bootstrap.js && npm run dev -w electron"
scripts.dev:electron: npm run build -w server && concurrently -k -s first -n server,web,electron -c green,cyan,magenta "npm run dev:server-for-electron" "cross-env AGENT_COMPANY_ELECTRON_RENDERER=1 npm run dev -w web -- --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on file:server/dist/bootstrap.js && npm run dev -w electron"
scripts.build: npm run build:root-ui && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web && npm run build -w electron
scripts.build:electron: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web && npm run build -w electron
